Ever wanted to burn something that wasn’t in arms’ reach? Turn up the heat on anything within 50 yards! This fire breathing monster is spewing burning kerosine-gas mixture at almost 2000 degrees fahrenheit!

Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)

Class: PQ Shotgun • Skill: Heavy Weapons • Range: Long Barrel Shotgun

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 4 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: This weapon cannot make Aimed Shots. Uses canisters of specialized fuel (50eb [Costly] per canister) as ammunition, which function as Armor-Piercing Shotgun Slugs that cannot cause Critical Injuries and, when they deal damage, set the target Deadly on Fire (6 HP damage a Turn). When this weapon rolls a Critical Failure (1), instead of jamming, a gust of flame spits out from a gap in its outer casing, immediately setting the user Mildly on Fire (2 HP damage a turn).

Range: Long Barrel Shotgun

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
